card.name: Digits inside numbers, dates and citations
card.fires_on: A single digit (4, 6, 7, 8, 9) within a longer number, such as a percentage, a year, a day of the month or a dollar figure. It is most common in census-style statistics, dates and reference citations.

modes.label: Digit in percentages and money
modes.description: A digit at the start or inside a statistic such as a percent or income amount.

modes.label: Digit in dates and years
modes.description: The second digit of a day or year, after a leading 1.

modes.label: Digit in citation numbers
modes.description: A digit in a report, volume or verse number in a reference.

card.plain: It lights up on a single digit in the middle of a number, like a year, a percentage or a reference number.
